description: Defines the TiffEntry class for handling TIFF IFD entries, including methods for reading, writing, and type management of TIFF tags within the Android image utils library.

classes.name: TiffEntry
classes.description: Represents a single TIFF IFD entry with methods for reading, writing, and type validation.

methods.name: writeTagInfo
methods.description: Serializes the TIFF IFD entry to output, handling offset and byte order.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of values for this TIFF entry.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the TIFF entry.

methods.name: getEndianness
methods.description: Returns the byte order for this entry.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Template method to retrieve the data pointer cast to a specific type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TIFF entry.

methods.name: forceValidType
methods.description: Ensures the data type matches the TIFF type, returning a cast pointer.

methods.name: getDataHelper
methods.description: Returns a void pointer to the data.
